BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS = 6 -- reward/choice/required rows per section (ref MAX_NUM_ITEMS -- =10 / MAX_REQUIRED_ITEMS=6 — the SAME v1 halving the quest -- log's own reward cap uses, QuestLogFrame.xml's own comment) BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES = 10 -- greeting title buttons (active + available combined; ref -- MAX_NUM_QUESTS=32, halved-and-then-some, an existing v1 cap) BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLLCHILD_H = 700 -- the generous scroll-child budget, see header comment
-- The detail write-on (ref QuestFrame.lua:4-6): the reveal edge moves at CPS characters -- per second, fading over LENGTH characters; the objectives/rewards block fades in over -- QUESTINFO_FADE_IN seconds once the text has fully written. QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH = 30 QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_CPS = 40 QUESTINFO_FADE_IN = 1
-- "Instant Quest Text" (ref UIOptionsFrame.lua:20 — uvar QUEST_FADING_DISABLE, checkbox -- default "0"). Pinned "1" by direction (2026-07-17): text lands whole, the greeting/ -- progress/reward fade-ins skip — and the quill still scratches ONCE, because that is -- what the ref's instant mode actually does (see the OnShow arm below): it jams the -- reveal edge past the text rather than skipping the write-on, so the first OnUpdate -- tick plays one WriteQuest before the gradient runs off. Instant is one scribble, not -- silence. -- -- The ref home for this uvar is the options window, and that is where it lives now: the -- Interface page's "Instant Quest Text" row drives it (decision 1136), and this assignment -- is the only place the default is written down. Note what that buys — our default is "1" -- where 1.12's table says "0", and because the row CAPTURES its default here rather than -- restating one, the Defaults button walks the page back to the director's pin, not to the -- reference's. Registered for save on the line below, so a player who prefers the fade-in -- keeps it (1128's load order: this assignment, then the saved chunk, then consumers). QUEST_FADING_DISABLE = "1" RegisterForSave("QUEST_FADING_DISABLE")
-- One quest-item row (kind = "choice"/"reward"/"required", 1-based `index`). Only reward -- rows use `usable`; required quest items keep the normal tint. function BenillaQuestItem_Set(button, kind, index) local name, texture, count, quality, usable, itemId = GetQuestItemInfo(kind, index) button.kind = kind button.index = index button.itemId = itemId -- ref l.388/490 ("-- For the tooltip"): every laid-out reward/choice row is stamped -- rewardType = "item"; the ONE row that ever reads "spell" is the reward-spell row -- (l.445), which v1 doesn't build (GetRewardSpell() is nil, decision 0088). The click -- arms below guard on it exactly as the ref does, so the guard is live the day that -- row lands. (Deviation, harmless: the ref leaves required rows' rewardType unset — -- l.197-200 stamps only `.type` — which reads the same `~= "spell"` either way.) button.rewardType = "item" button.quality = quality button.icon:SetTexture(texture or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON) button.name:SetText(name or "...") if (count or 1) > 1 then button.count:SetText(count) else button.count:SetText("") end local r, g, b = 1, 1, 1 if quality and BenillaTooltip_QualityColor then r, g, b = BenillaTooltip_QualityColor(quality) end button.name:SetTextColor(r, g, b) if kind ~= "required" and not usable then button.icon:SetVertexColor(0.9, 0, 0) getglobal(button:GetName() .. "NameFrame"):SetVertexColor(0.9, 0, 0) else button.icon:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) getglobal(button:GetName() .. "NameFrame"):SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) end button:Show() end
-- ── The shared panel scroll kit: wheel + arrows + the minimal visual scrollbar + the -- measured child resize (the quest log's own kit, generalized by NAME — a panel's bar is -- "<scroll>Bar", its child "<scroll>Child"; QuestLogFrame.xml's SyncBar comment covers the -- no-Slider/no-drag deferral). ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_STEP = 20 BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_TRACK_H = 302 -- 334-tall scroll, minus the two 16px arrows BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_THUMB_H = 16
function BenillaQuestScroll_Step(sf, delta) sf:SetVerticalScroll(sf:GetVerticalScroll() + delta) -- engine clamps to [0, range] BenillaQuestScroll_SyncBar(sf) end
-- WoW wheel convention: +1 per notch up, -1 down — up lifts the content. function BenillaQuestScroll_OnMouseWheel(frame, delta) BenillaQuestScroll_Step(frame, -delta * BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_STEP) end
-- The log's SyncBar, name-generalized: hide the whole bar when nothing overflows, dead-end -- the arrows, seat the thumb at the scroll fraction. function BenillaQuestScroll_SyncBar(sf) local n = sf:GetName() local bar = getglobal(n .. "Bar") if not bar then return end local value = sf:GetVerticalScroll() local range = sf:GetVerticalScrollRange() if range <= 0 then bar:Hide() return end bar:Show() if value > 0 then getglobal(n .. "BarUp"):Enable() else getglobal(n .. "BarUp"):Disable() end if value < range then getglobal(n .. "BarDown"):Enable() else getglobal(n .. "BarDown"):Disable() end local travel = BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_TRACK_H - BENILLA_QUEST_SCROLL_THUMB_H getglobal(n .. "BarThumb"):SetPoint( "TOPLEFT", getglobal(n .. "BarTrack"), "TOPLEFT", 0, -(value / range * travel)) end
-- Size the ACTIVE panel's scroll child to its measured content — the shared real-scroll -- kit's `BenillaScroll_ResizeChild` (ScrollTemplates.xml), which owns the widget-bottom sum, -- the change-guard, and the UpdateScrollChildRect. Only the bar sync stays here: this window -- wears the minimal no-drag bar, not the kit's Slider (see the scrollbar markup below). function BenillaQuestPanel_Resize(scrollName, widgets) if BenillaScroll_ResizeChild(scrollName, widgets) then BenillaQuestScroll_SyncBar(getglobal(scrollName)) end end
-- Per-panel resize candidates: every element that can be the LOWEST visible thing. BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_WIDGETS = { ["QuestGreetingScroll"] = (function() local t = { "QuestGreetingText", "QuestActiveHeader", "QuestAvailableHeader" } for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES do table.insert(t, "QuestTitleButton" .. i) end return t end)(), ["QuestDetailScroll"] = (function() local t = { "QuestDetailBody", "QuestDetailObjective", "QuestDetailRewardTitleText", "QuestDetailItemChooseText", "QuestDetailItemReceiveText" } for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do table.insert(t, "QuestDetailChoice" .. i) table.insert(t, "QuestDetailReward" .. i) end for i = 1, 3 do table.insert(t, "QuestDetailMoneyCoin" .. i) end return t end)(), ["QuestProgressScroll"] = { "QuestProgressBody", "QuestProgressRequiredText", "QuestProgressRequiredMoneyText", "QuestProgressMoneyCoin1", "QuestProgressMoneyCoin2", "QuestProgressMoneyCoin3" }, ["QuestRewardScroll"] = (function() local t = { "QuestRewardBody", "QuestRewardRewardTitleText", "QuestRewardItemChooseText", "QuestRewardItemReceiveText" } for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do table.insert(t, "QuestRewardChoice" .. i) table.insert(t, "QuestRewardReward" .. i) end for i = 1, 3 do table.insert(t, "QuestRewardMoneyCoin" .. i) end return t end)(), }
BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_SCROLLS = { greeting = "QuestGreetingScroll", detail = "QuestDetailScroll", progress = "QuestProgressScroll", reward = "QuestRewardScroll", }
-- The convergence driver: while the window shows, keep re-measuring the ACTIVE panel -- (cheap — the resize itself no-ops once the sum stabilizes; the log's own OnUpdate idiom). -- The greeting panel's title rows fit FIRST, so the panel sum below already sees their -- final bottoms in this same pass. function BenillaQuestFrame_OnUpdate() local frame = getglobal("QuestFrame") if not frame:IsVisible() or not frame.panel then return end if frame.panel == "greeting" then for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES do local button = getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. i) if button:IsShown() then BenillaQuestTitleButton_Resize(button) end end end local scroll = BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_SCROLLS[frame.panel] if scroll then BenillaQuestPanel_Resize(scroll, BENILLA_QUEST_PANEL_WIDGETS[scroll]) end end
-- ── Greeting panel (ref QuestFrameGreetingPanel_OnShow, QuestFrame.lua:219-282) ────────────── function QuestTitleButton_OnClick() local button = this if button.isActive then SelectActiveQuest(button.titleIndex) else SelectAvailableQuest(button.titleIndex) end PlaySound("igQuestListSelect") -- ref QuestTitleButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:303 end
-- A title row is as tall as its own wrapped title, +2 (ref QuestFrameGreetingPanel_OnShow's -- `SetHeight(GetTextHeight() + 2)`, QuestFrame.lua:243/272 — the same law GossipFrame.xml's -- `BenillaGossipRow_Resize` runs on the gossip rows). Titles wrap at the ButtonText's 275 px, -- and the rows hang off each other, so a row left at the template's 16px while its title -- draws two lines prints the next title through it. Our GetStringHeight lands a frame after -- the SetText (the measure round-trip), hence the guard + the OnUpdate settle above. function BenillaQuestTitleButton_Resize(button) local text = button:GetFontString() local h = text and text:GetHeight() or 0 if h <= 0 or button.benillaFitHeight == h then return end button.benillaFitHeight = h button:SetHeight(h + 2) end
function BenillaQuestGreetingPanel_OnShow() getglobal("QuestDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestProgressPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestRewardPanel"):Hide()
local greetingText = getglobal("QuestGreetingText") greetingText:SetText(GetGreetingText() or "") local activeHeader = getglobal("QuestActiveHeader") local availableHeader = getglobal("QuestAvailableHeader") local hbreak = getglobal("QuestGreetingBreak") local numActive = math.min(GetNumActiveQuests(), BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES) local numAvailable = math.min(GetNumAvailableQuests(), BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES - numActive)
-- Current Quests + its title-button run (l.235-253). if numActive == 0 then activeHeader:SetText("") else activeHeader:SetText("Current Quests") activeHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", greetingText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) for i = 1, numActive do local button = getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. i) button.isActive = true button.titleIndex = i button:SetText(GetActiveTitle(i)) BenillaQuestTitleButton_Resize(button) button:Show() if i == 1 then button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", activeHeader, "BOTTOMLEFT", -10, -5) else button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. (i - 1)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) end end end
-- The horizontal break + Available Quests + ITS title-button run (l.254-278) — the break -- shows only when BOTH lists are non-empty (l.256-260). if numActive > 0 and numAvailable > 0 then hbreak:SetTexture("Interface\\QuestFrame\\UI-HorizontalBreak") hbreak:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. numActive), "BOTTOMLEFT", 22, -10) else hbreak:SetTexture(nil) end if numAvailable == 0 then availableHeader:SetText("") else availableHeader:SetText("Available Quests") if numActive > 0 then availableHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", hbreak, "BOTTOMLEFT", -12, -10) else availableHeader:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", greetingText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) end for i = numActive + 1, numActive + numAvailable do local button = getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. i) button.isActive = false button.titleIndex = i - numActive button:SetText(GetAvailableTitle(i - numActive)) BenillaQuestTitleButton_Resize(button) button:Show() if i == numActive + 1 then button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", availableHeader, "BOTTOMLEFT", -10, -5) else button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. (i - 1)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) end end end for i = numActive + numAvailable + 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_TITLES do getglobal("QuestTitleButton" .. i):Hide() end
getglobal("QuestGreetingScroll"):SetVerticalScroll(0) -- The action button inherits `hidden="true"` from `BenillaQuestPanelButtonTemplate` -- (a virtual template — never itself drawn — declared hidden so a bare `inherits=` alone -- doesn't imply "visible"); every panel must :Show() its own buttons explicitly, the same -- way BenillaQuestItem_Set already does for item/title rows. getglobal("QuestGreetingGoodbyeButton"):Show() if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then -- ref l.223-226: instant text skips the fade-in UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("QuestGreetingScrollChild"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
function BenillaQuestGreetingGoodbyeButton_OnClick() -- ref l.749-752: no DeclineQuest() call here — the greeting has no in-progress panel to -- decline yet. The window's own OnHide (CloseQuest()) still ends the giver session. HideUIPanel(getglobal("QuestFrame")) end
-- ── The shared reward/choice grid (ref's `QuestFrameItems_Update`, QuestFrame.lua:311-522) — -- ported line-for-line, the SAME idiom `QuestLogFrame.xml`'s `BenillaQuestLogRewards_Update` -- already proved: 2-per-row, odd index starts a new row under the row two back, even index -- sits beside the previous. `prefix` is "QuestDetail" or "QuestReward" — both -- panels read the SAME giver getters (`GetNumQuestChoices`/`GetQuestItemInfo`/`GetRewardMoney` -- are giver-global, not panel-specific — `benilla-ui`'s `quest.rs`), only the widget names -- differ (the ref's own two panels are likewise fed by the one shared function). ────────────── function BenillaQuestItems_Update(prefix) local numChoices = GetNumQuestChoices() local numRewards = GetNumQuestRewards() local money = GetRewardMoney()
-- l.343-349: the "Rewards" header shows iff there's anything at all to show. local header = getglobal(prefix .. "RewardTitleText") local haveAnyReward = numChoices > 0 or numRewards > 0 or (money and money > 0) header:SetText(haveAnyReward and "Rewards" or "")
-- l.367-413: choosable rewards. local chooseText = getglobal(prefix .. "ItemChooseText") local lastChoice = math.min(numChoices, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS) chooseText:SetText(numChoices > 0 and "You may choose one of these rewards:" or "") for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do local choice = getglobal(prefix .. "Choice" .. i) if i <= lastChoice then BenillaQuestItem_Set(choice, "choice", i) if i == 1 then choice:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", chooseText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) elseif i % 2 == 1 then choice:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Choice" .. (i - 2)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -2) else choice:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Choice" .. (i - 1)), "TOPRIGHT", 1, 0) end else choice:Hide() end end
-- l.454-473: "You will receive:"/"You will also receive:" — shown for a fixed reward OR -- money, even with zero fixed-reward rows (money-only quest). local receiveText = getglobal(prefix .. "ItemReceiveText") local haveFixed = numRewards > 0 or (money and money > 0) if haveFixed then if numChoices > 0 then receiveText:SetText("You will also receive:") local anchorIndex = lastChoice if anchorIndex % 2 == 0 then anchorIndex = anchorIndex - 1 end receiveText:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Choice" .. anchorIndex), "BOTTOMLEFT", 3, -5) else receiveText:SetText("You will receive:") receiveText:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", header, "BOTTOMLEFT", 3, -5) end else receiveText:SetText("") end
-- l.474-513: fixed rewards, same 2-per-row pattern chained off ItemReceiveText. local lastReward = math.min(numRewards, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS) for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do local reward = getglobal(prefix .. "Reward" .. i) if i <= lastReward then BenillaQuestItem_Set(reward, "reward", i) if i == 1 then reward:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", receiveText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) elseif i % 2 == 1 then reward:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Reward" .. (i - 2)), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -2) else reward:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", getglobal(prefix .. "Reward" .. (i - 1)), "TOPRIGHT", 1, 0) end else reward:Hide() end end
if money and money > 0 then BenillaMoney_Set(prefix .. "Money", money, true) else BenillaMoney_Clear(prefix .. "Money") end end
-- ── Detail panel (ref QuestFrameDetailPanel_OnShow, QuestFrame.lua:524-552) ────────────────── function BenillaQuestDetailPanel_OnShow() getglobal("QuestGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestProgressPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestRewardPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("QuestDetailTitle"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("QuestDetailBody"):SetText(GetQuestText() or "") getglobal("QuestDetailObjectiveHeader"):SetText("Quest Objectives") getglobal("QuestDetailObjective"):SetText(GetObjectiveText() or "") BenillaQuestItems_Update("QuestDetail") getglobal("QuestDetailScroll"):SetVerticalScroll(0) getglobal("QuestAcceptButton"):Show() getglobal("QuestDeclineButton"):Show()
-- Arm the write-on (ref l.538-551): objectives/rewards invisible and Accept dead -- until the description has finished writing itself onto the parchment. getglobal("QuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"):SetAlpha(0) getglobal("QuestAcceptButton"):Disable() local panel = getglobal("QuestDetailPanel") panel.fading = 1 panel.fadingProgress = 0 getglobal("QuestDetailBody"):SetAlphaGradient(0, QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH) -- Instant text (ref l.549-551): the write-on still arms, but the reveal edge starts -- past any quest text's end — the first OnUpdate tick scratches the quill once, runs -- the gradient off, and wakes everything on the spot. if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "1" then panel.fadingProgress = 1024 end end
-- ref QuestFrameDetailPanel_OnUpdate (QuestFrame.lua:555-570): advance the reveal edge, -- scratching the WriteQuest quill each tick — the kit's no-duplicates flag (0x20) keeps -- the per-frame PlaySound from stacking (a new scribble only starts when the previous -- wav ends, which IS the continuous writing sound). When the gradient runs off the end -- of the text, fade the objectives/rewards block in (or snap it on, instant mode) and -- wake the Accept button. With instant text the arm above started the edge at 1024, so -- all of this happens on the first tick: one scratch, then the wake. function BenillaQuestDetailPanel_OnUpdate(panel, elapsed) if panel.fading then panel.fadingProgress = panel.fadingProgress + (elapsed * QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_CPS) PlaySound("WriteQuest") if not getglobal("QuestDetailBody"):SetAlphaGradient(panel.fadingProgress, QUEST_DESCRIPTION_GRADIENT_LENGTH) then panel.fading = nil if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("QuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) else -- instant: the block snaps on, no fade (ref l.561-564) getglobal("QuestDetailTextAlphaFrame"):SetAlpha(1) end getglobal("QuestAcceptButton"):Enable() end end end
function QuestDetailAcceptButton_OnClick() AcceptQuest() end
function QuestDetailDeclineButton_OnClick() -- vanilla's client-side decline sends no packet; hide immediately (no one-frame lag, -- the same convention every NPC window's close button already uses — e.g. -- BenillaMerchantCloseButton_OnClick). DeclineQuest() PlaySound("igQuestCancel") -- ref QuestDetailDeclineButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:577 HideUIPanel(getglobal("QuestFrame")) end
-- ── Progress panel (ref QuestFrameProgressPanel_OnShow/Items_Update, QuestFrame.lua:143-217) -- ITS OWN grid — NOT the choose/reward one above: item1 is the only Lua-repositioned row (below -- the required-money line when money is required, else below the header directly, l.186-192); -- items 2-6 are a STATIC XML 2-column×3-row chain off item1/item3/item5 (ref l.416-460) that -- the resolver's fixpoint keeps correctly re-propagated as item1 moves — no Lua needed for -- them at all. ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaQuestProgressPanel_OnShow() getglobal("QuestGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestRewardPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("QuestProgressTitle"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("QuestProgressBody"):SetText(GetProgressText() or "")
local numItems = math.min(GetNumQuestItems(), BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS) local money = GetQuestMoneyToGet() local reqText = getglobal("QuestProgressRequiredText") local moneyText = getglobal("QuestProgressRequiredMoneyText") local item1 = getglobal("QuestProgressRequired1") if numItems > 0 or (money and money > 0) then reqText:SetText("Items Needed:") if money and money > 0 then moneyText:SetText("Required Money:") BenillaMoney_Set("QuestProgressMoney", money, true) item1:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", moneyText, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) else moneyText:SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear("QuestProgressMoney") item1:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", reqText, "BOTTOMLEFT", -3, -5) end else reqText:SetText("") moneyText:SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear("QuestProgressMoney") end for i = 1, BENILLA_QUEST_MAX_ITEMS do if i <= numItems then BenillaQuestItem_Set(getglobal("QuestProgressRequired" .. i), "required", i) else getglobal("QuestProgressRequired" .. i):Hide() end end
local continueButton = getglobal("QuestProgressContinueButton") if IsQuestCompletable() then continueButton:Enable() else continueButton:Disable() end continueButton:Show() getglobal("QuestProgressGoodbyeButton"):Show() getglobal("QuestProgressScroll"):SetVerticalScroll(0) if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then -- ref l.159-162: instant text skips the fade-in UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("QuestProgressScrollChild"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
function BenillaQuestProgressContinueButton_OnClick() CompleteQuest() -- the progress panel's "Continue" — requests the reward offer end
function BenillaQuestProgressGoodbyeButton_OnClick() DeclineQuest() PlaySound("igQuestCancel") -- ref QuestGoodbyeButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:112 HideUIPanel(getglobal("QuestFrame")) end
-- ── Reward panel (ref QuestFrameRewardPanel_OnShow + reward-item clicks, QuestFrame.lua:72-141) function BenillaQuestRewardPanel_OnShow() getglobal("QuestGreetingPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestDetailPanel"):Hide() getglobal("QuestProgressPanel"):Hide()
getglobal("QuestRewardTitle"):SetText(GetTitleText() or "") getglobal("QuestRewardBody"):SetText(GetRewardText() or "") getglobal("QuestFrame").itemChoice = 0 getglobal("QuestRewardChoiceHighlight"):Hide() BenillaQuestItems_Update("QuestReward") getglobal("QuestRewardScroll"):SetVerticalScroll(0) getglobal("QuestRewardCompleteButton"):Show() getglobal("QuestRewardCancelButton"):Show() -- ref l.85-88: the whole parchment content fades in — unless the text is instant. if QUEST_FADING_DISABLE == "0" then getglobal("QuestRewardScrollChild"):SetAlpha(0) UIFrameFadeIn(getglobal("QuestRewardScrollChild"), QUESTINFO_FADE_IN) end end
-- ── The item-row modifier fork, shared by every quest-item row in this window ───────────── -- ref QuestItem_OnClick (QuestFrame.lua:115-125), the OnClick QuestItemTemplate itself -- carries (QuestFrameTemplates.xml:162-164) — so it covers the DETAIL panel's choice/reward -- rows, the PROGRESS panel's required rows, and the reward panel's FIXED reward rows. -- CTRL previews the item in the dressing room (decision 1060), SHIFT posts its link into an -- open chat edit box (decision 1059); a plain click does nothing here, which is why these -- rows carried no OnClick before this arc. -- -- Two guards the ref's own code has, transcribed: the ctrl arm is gated on -- `this.rewardType ~= "spell"` (l.117 — a spell reward has no item to wear), and the shift -- arm additionally requires the edit box to be VISIBLE (l.121; the `and rewardType ~= -- "spell"` rides the same line there). Ours adds `ChatFrameEditBox and` — ChatFrame.xml is -- a separate file a window test need not load, exactly as BenillaPaperDollSlot_OnClick does. -- -- One benilla-only guard: `link` is nil until the ask-once item template lands (a state the -- reference's synchronous item cache never has), and EditBox:Insert takes a string. The ref -- already carries the twin of this guard inside DressUpItemLink (ref DressUpFrame.lua:11-13). function QuestItem_OnClick() local button = this if IsControlKeyDown() then if button.rewardType ~= "spell" then DressUpItemLink(GetQuestItemLink(button.kind, button.index)) end elseif IsShiftKeyDown() then -- The ref's spell guard rides this arm (l.121); the "edit box up" and "link not -- nil" pair is the shared helper's (UIParent.xml — one law, one place). if button.rewardType ~= "spell" then BenillaChatEdit_InsertLink(GetQuestItemLink(button.kind, button.index)) end end end
-- ref QuestRewardItem_OnClick (l.127-141), the OnClick the REWARD panel's choice rows carry -- through QuestRewardItemTemplate (QuestFrameTemplates.xml:169-171). The first two arms are -- QuestItem_OnClick's verbatim (only the shift arm's spell guard differs — the ref drops it -- here, l.133); the choice SELECT is the THIRD arm, so a ctrl- or shift-click must NOT also -- pick the reward. That ordering is the whole point of the fork. function QuestRewardItem_OnClick() local button = this if IsControlKeyDown() then if button.rewardType ~= "spell" then DressUpItemLink(GetQuestItemLink(button.kind, button.index)) end elseif IsShiftKeyDown() then -- No spell guard on this arm — the ref drops it here (l.133). The visible/non-nil -- pair is the shared helper's (UIParent.xml). BenillaChatEdit_InsertLink(GetQuestItemLink(button.kind, button.index)) elseif button.kind == "choice" then -- ref l.136's own `this.type == "choice"` test. The ref needs it because its reward -- panel packs choices AND fixed rewards into ONE QuestRewardItem1..10 pool; ours -- keeps two pools and hangs this template only on QuestRewardChoice*, so the -- test is belt-and-braces — kept because it is the ref's, and because it is what -- makes the template safe to reuse if the pools are ever merged. BenillaQuestRewardChoice_OnClick(button) end end
-- The third arm alone (ref l.136-139): only a REWARD-panel choice row is selectable — the -- detail panel's rows and both panels' FIXED reward rows ride the plain -- `QuestItemTemplate`, whose OnClick has no select arm at all, matching the ref's -- separate QuestRewardItemTemplate vs QuestItemTemplate. function BenillaQuestRewardChoice_OnClick(button) getglobal("QuestFrame").itemChoice = button.index -- Ref QuestRewardItem_OnClick l.137-138 verbatim: the glow frame seats at (-8,7) on -- the clicked row's TOPLEFT. local hl = getglobal("QuestRewardChoiceHighlight") hl:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", button, "TOPLEFT", -8, 7) hl:Show() end
function QuestRewardCompleteButton_OnClick() local choice = getglobal("QuestFrame").itemChoice or 0 if GetNumQuestChoices() > 0 and choice == 0 then return end -- must pick a choice first GetQuestReward(math.max(choice - 1, 0)) -- 1-based row -> 0-based wire index PlaySound("igQuestListComplete") -- ref QuestRewardCompleteButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:101 end
function QuestRewardCancelButton_OnClick() DeclineQuest() PlaySound("igQuestCancel") -- ref QuestRewardCancelButton_OnClick, QuestFrame.lua:93 HideUIPanel(getglobal("QuestFrame")) end
-- ── Window lifecycle (ref QuestFrame_OnLoad/OnEvent, QuestFrame.lua:8-70) ──────────────────── function QuestFrame_OnLoad() local frame = this -- The NPC portrait: the "npc" unit token → the questgiver's live model bake -- (crates/benilla/src/portrait, InteractNpc) — the same binding MerchantFrame/GossipFrame use. SetPortraitTexture(getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "Portrait"), "npc") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_GREETING") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_DETAIL") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_PROGRESS") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_COMPLETE") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_ITEM_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("QUEST_FINISHED") frame.itemChoice = 0 frame.panel = nil end
-- Re-run whichever panel is currently live (QUEST_ITEM_UPDATE — an in-place row refresh, e.g. -- an item name landing async; ref l.45-58 calls the item-grid function directly rather than -- re-showing the panel — re-running the panel's own OnShow here is equivalent AND simpler: it -- reads the same live QuestState, so title/body come out unchanged and only the rows actually -- differ). function BenillaQuestFrame_Repaint(panel) if panel == "greeting" then BenillaQuestGreetingPanel_OnShow() elseif panel == "detail" then BenillaQuestDetailPanel_OnShow() elseif panel == "progress" then BenillaQuestProgressPanel_OnShow() elseif panel == "reward" then BenillaQuestRewardPanel_OnShow() end end
function QuestFrame_OnEvent(event) local frame = this if event == "QUEST_FINISHED" then HideUIPanel(frame) frame.panel = nil return end if event == "QUEST_ITEM_UPDATE" then -- The in-place refresh also carries the NPC name (arg1) — in live play the ask-once -- name often lands one frame AFTER the panel opened, arriving exactly here; dropping -- it left the title bar blank (caught reviewing the ui-quest capture). if arg1 and arg1 ~= "" then getglobal("QuestNpcNameText"):SetText(arg1) end if frame:IsVisible() and frame.panel then BenillaQuestFrame_Repaint(frame.panel) end return end
getglobal("QuestNpcNameText"):SetText(arg1 or "") if event == "QUEST_GREETING" then frame.panel = "greeting" elseif event == "QUEST_DETAIL" then frame.panel = "detail" elseif event == "QUEST_PROGRESS" then frame.panel = "progress" elseif event == "QUEST_COMPLETE" then frame.panel = "reward" end
ShowUIPanel(frame) -- ref l.33-44: Hide() then Show() the target CHILD panel — forces its own OnShow to run -- (which hides the other three siblings + repaints itself), even on a same-panel refresh -- (e.g. re-QUERY_QUEST on the same NPC while Detail is already open). local names = { greeting = "QuestGreetingPanel", detail = "QuestDetailPanel", progress = "QuestProgressPanel", reward = "QuestRewardPanel", } local target = getglobal(names[frame.panel]) target:Hide() target:Show() end
function BenillaQuestCloseButton_OnClick() CloseQuest() HideUIPanel(getglobal("QuestFrame")) end
